messages:
Aisha: Quick async standup — evening check-in. TL;DR: I'm proposing a small SLO/alert tweak + canary.

What I did:
- Pulled 24h p95/p99 latency for inference routes, saw p99 baseline ~420ms with spikes around deploy windows.
- Opened PR to adjust noisy alerting + add canary gating: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321
- Drafted runbook change for slow-start/coldstart behavior (link below).

Blockers / concerns:
- Lowering p99 alert threshold from 450ms -> 350ms will reduce noise, but might cause pages during warmup. Need a safe canary and short mute window for rolling deploys.
- Need data query & quick histogram to ensure improvement signal isn't just tail amplification from retries.

Today / ask:
- Can someone run the attached query and share histogram counts for p50/p90/p99 over last 24h?
- +1 on the PR if you can approve the canary gating.
- Add a short blameless note to the runbook about deploy warmup.

ops-bot: Auto-alert-summary: 3 pages in last 24h for inference.p99 latency > 450ms. Median page gap 18m.

Ravi: Can run the query now. Also share the exact query snippet so I don't guess the tags.

Aisha: Thanks — use this:
```sql
SELECT histogram(latency_ms, 50, 90, 99) AS percentiles, count(*) AS cnt
FROM request_metrics
WHERE service = 'inference' AND env = 'prod' AND ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY route;
```

Morgan: Running it now, will post results in ~5m. Also +1 on gating canary. We should do a 1-hour canary with traffic cutover 10% -> 50% before full.

pagerbot: Pager duty summary: oncall Ben paged twice for latency spikes (both within deploy windows).

Ravi: Results pasted (short form):
- route /chat: p50 85ms, p90 210ms, p99 415ms, cnt 1.2M
- route /embed: p50 40ms, p90 120ms, p99 380ms, cnt 430k
- route /rerank: p50 120ms, p90 300ms, p99 480ms, cnt 90k

Ravi: Noticed rerank has the worst tail — correlates with occasional coldstart on node-scheduler. We can lower alert for /chat and /embed to 350ms, but keep /rerank at 450ms for now.

Morgan: Agreed. I'll take the canary run tonight at 21:00 UTC. Ben — can you review and approve the PR gating so we can start the canary? Link to PR again: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321

Ben: I'm around. I'll skim the PR now. Quick note: include a short temporary mute in the deployment pipeline (2m) for initial warmup so we don't page on known warmups. Put that as a flag in the rollout config.

Aisha: Perfect. Action items: 
- Morgan: run 1h canary at 21:00 UTC (10%->50% traffic).
- Ben: add 2m warmup mute flag + review/merge PR.
- Ravi: file a follow-up ticket to investigate rerank coldstarts (link /tickets/INF-824).
- I will update runbook: /wiki/runbooks/inference-latency.md

ops-bot: Noted. Will suppress automated p99 alerts for the canary time window if rollout flag set.

Morgan: I'll post canary signal summary in this thread after 1h.

Ben: +1 to the plan. Approving the gating in PR now.

Aisha: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Will add a short blameless note and close the loop tomorrow morning.
